note: Section 4.6 requires the Restart timer to be configurable. TestConfiguredLCPRestartTimer observes SCR's exact 500 ms and 3 s periods, rejects early expiry and checks timer cancellation on Opened. A fixed period fails the configured interval. Both server transport configuration paths supply the validated session setting read by armRestartTimer. Client LCP and IPv6CP have separate schema-backed interval snapshots and one-shot request timers; the server tags here claim the shared server timer's exact expiry and cancellation, rather than proof of every client lifecycle.
